_comment: Full-capture config for deep-context Slack extraction. Edit by hand. Channels/users listed here get ALL messages captured (not just your own participation) — useful for channels you follow but rarely post in. Leave the arrays empty to capture nothing extra; `extract slack` still runs the from: (your messages) and mentions passes regardless. Run a specific pass with `extract slack-channel-full` / `extract slack-user-full`.

full_capture_channels._example: Remove this example and add your own. workspace must match a key in OWNER_CONFIG.slackIdentifiers; channel_id is the Slack channel ID (Cxxxxxxxx).
